name: Pharos Skill Engine OATH adapter
integrationType: Agent Skill workflow adapter; the upstream package provides SKILL.md and references, not a hosted runtime API
execution: OATH selects these workflows from natural-language intent and runs them through chain-ID-verified Pharos JSON-RPC or the hosted Pharos Chain MCP.
security: Read-only workflow tools. OATH does not accept, store, or pass private keys. Transaction signing and broadcasting stay in the connected wallet.

workflows.intent: Check Pharos network identity, latest block, and gas information
Read a wallet's native balance, code status, nonce, and block
Inspect deployed bytecode and a SHA-256 fingerprint
Read transaction details and receipt status
Check a failed transaction's receipt and report limits where traces are unavailable
Read the allowance for a specified token, owner, and spender
Estimate gas and fee for a supplied transaction; never submit it
Read a wallet-submitted transaction and receipt
Find and retrieve relevant live Pharos developer documentation
